Regenerate with `node scripts/perf-budgets.ts --update` and READ THE DIFF: a new entry here is §8 item 2's "called out". `csp` is the base64 SHA-256 of the block's dist bytes, which is exactly the token deploy/Caddyfile's SR-10 script-src will need. Sizes are RAW bytes and gzip is deliberately not recorded: the gzipped size depends on the zlib the run happens to link, so a recorded one differs between a laptop and a runner and would ask to be updated forever, on both, in turn. The budget is still checked against a live gzip measurement; it is only the stored number that has to be reproducible.
